name: Gasthof Goldene Krone
beschreibung:
Set in the center of the market town Reutte, the historic Gasthof Goldene Krone features stylish rooms and exquisite regional dining. It provides a perfect base for cultural visits and outdoor adventures.

The Highline179 suspension bridge, Ehrenberg Castle, Lake Plansee, and the Hahnenkamm cable car are reached in minutes.
kurzbeschreibung: The historic Gasthof Goldene Krone in Reutte offers traditional inn culture in the Nature Park region.
